title: Statistical acceptance protocol for v5: exact pooled test + Holm, non-binding futility, pre-registered NI margins, unknowns by kind, and a seed-toggle positive-control fixture (spike-in control refuted by pilot)
verdict_cn:
结论：这套“怎么判定一条规则算数”的统计规则可以做，难度不高，大约两百行代码，所用方法都是成熟的标准做法。但它不会凭空变出检测能力：它能把误判率算清楚、省钱，却不能让 v3 里那些效果只有 1 到 3 分的规则变得“看得见”。
现在的问题：v3 的判定标准是“至少多对 1 题”，没有明确的误判率。同一段文字拿来和自己比，有 14% 到 17% 的概率被判成“有效”；而在文档问答（OfficeQA）和数学选择题（LiveMath）上，一条让成绩掉 10 分的规则，有 38% 到 39% 的概率被放过去。
新方案的要点：（1）试验轮和复核轮的数据合在一起，做一次精确检验，再对同一步里最多 5 条规则统一做“多重比较校正”，也就是把总误判率控制在 5% 以内；（2）一条规则在前两次运行里不占优，就提前停掉，按 v3 的记录算，规则相关的花费能省约一半；（3）“不伤害其他题”要用事先定好的允许掉分幅度来检验，五个评测集分别为 6、10、9、15、25 分；（4）网络故障导致的空结果直接剔除，不再算作规则的失败。
试点已跑完：共 2000 次调用，花了约 293 万 token，没有失败调用。原计划的“标准答案对照”是把 6 道题的答案直接写进规则，结果它除了答对这 6 题，还让其他做错过的题平均提高了 16.5 分，所以不能当作效果已知的标尺。只改回答格式的效果，其实来自示范例子，而不是那句说明本身。另一种对照是加上任务说明书，它在两次独立测量中都提高约 8 到 9.5 分，结果稳定，因此改用它作为每轮的固定对照。
局限：效果只有 3 分左右的差别，单条规则根本测不出来，只能在整个版本层面测，每一步要花约 2 千万到 7 千万 token。
what_i_did: Second pass of D8 (the first pass left the verdict and pilot sections as placeholders; its pilot finished after its interim analysis). (1) Read the shared context and the earlier pass's 55 KB report, scripts and data. (2) Found that the pilot had completed on the old machine (2,000/2,000 cells, 00:05-02:07, 0 unknown) and that the Mac interim analysis (904 cells) was invalid: it imputed not-yet-returned cells with the L/H convention, producing a spurious negative spike gain. Re-extracted the cells from the pilot's own output root and re-ran the pre-registered analysis P1-P5 on all 2,000 cells. (3) Added exploratory analyses: where the spike's collateral effect sits (eligible vs never-failed items), what the flips look like (prediction artifacts, 79 flip cells, 12 read by hand), seed-control reproducibility across sessions, calibration-panel detection rates for the seed control, and NI/C1 behaviour of the spike. (4) Verified the earlier pass's headline facts with my own code: cal-1 counts directly from the 8,816 source cell files plus the frozen unit.json; all pairwise contrasts; dead items and eligibility; a brute-force exact test on the recorded s1-r1/s1-r3 cells (worked example); the s1-r1 rest-panel numbers; margin, MDE and sample-size arithmetic; protocol constants in protocol.py; and the 17/17 match of the replayed v3 gate verdicts with the frozen unit verdicts. (5) Settled the '21 vs 15 unknown runs' discrepancy against the frozen record. (6) Rewrote the fixture design (Section 4.8) and the related verdict, risk, cost, recommendation and change-log sections, and added a verification log. (7) Copied the report and run3 files to /data/feasibility/D8 on the new machine. No repository or run directory was modified; no test/holdout data were touched.
evidence: MEASURED (cal-1 complete, 11 arms x 200 SearchQA training items x 4 runs = 8,800 cells, 6,008 pass / 2,777 fail / 15 unknown, re-counted from source): same text re-dispatched (parent:B - parent:A) +0.75 pt (se 0.99), SD of per-item diffs 0.139 at 4 runs, 36/200 discordant; placebos -3.75 / +3.38 / -10.0 / 0.0 pt; ids-full +9.17, seed-only +8.75, seed-rule +0.29, seed-rule3 -3.12, cand (= v3 s1-r1) -2.75 pt vs parent:A; 25 dead items, all inside the 74-item eligibility pool. v3: 17 judged rule arms, replayed C1 gain and C2 delta = frozen verdicts 17/17. Worked example s1-r1 (brute force): screen exact p 0.00765, confirm 0.00051, pooled 7.75e-6, gain +1.875 items; rest 186 items pooled -3.09 pt, LB95 -6.62, cross-round r 0.570 -> fails a 6-pt NI margin (the registered gate failed it on confirm C2, -7.5 items vs tolerance -7). PILOT (measured, 2,000 cells, same 200 items): spike6 targets 22/24 runs vs parent 8/24 (exact p 3.9e-6); non-targets +5.80 pt [+1.95, +9.65] (39 up / 17 down), of which +16.5 pt on 68 eligible non-targets and 0.00 on 126 never-failed items; 76% of the spike's +14.75-item total is off-target; the spike passes C2' (LB +2.57 pt > -6). Seed-only - parent (2 runs): +9.50 (se 2.25) pilot vs +8.25 (se 2.12) cal-1, difference +1.25 (se 1.96), per-item r 0.60. Session drift parent:C vs cal-1: -1.87 pt (se 1.04), not flagged. Exploratory split-half null: registered gain>=1 false-pass 0.136-0.173, exact test 0.005-0.018 at nominal 0.05. 11/79 flip cells: the parent replied with a JSON answer object that exact match failed. ESTIMATED (simulations from the earlier pass, not re-run here; b12b replicates b12): v5 C1' power for a seed-sized effect 0.637 (0.683 without the placebo condition) vs 0.568 registered, FWER 0.005-0.024; futility look 1 would have saved 15.6M of 27.0M rule-arm tokens (net ~-13.4M) and stopped 0 of the 3 registered C1 passers; registered C2 passes a 10-pt harm 38-39% on OfficeQA/LiveMath.
design: (1) Within-round comparisons only, paired by item and run. (2) C1' benefit: exact conditional stratified (CMH-type) one-sided test, strata = (item, round), x_s ~ Hypergeometric(N_s, m_s, k_R) under H0, p = P(T >= t_obs), on pooled screen + confirm data; Holm at alpha 0.05 over the step's m <= 5 supported proposals (stopped or unjudged proposals enter with p = 1); plus G >= 1 item and beats both kept placebos. (3) Non-binding futility: look 1 after trigger runs 0-1 (stop if G_1 <= 0), look 2 at the end of the screen (stop if G_2 <= 0 or rest mean <= -delta_C2); dispatch rest/regression/forward cells only for look-1 survivors. (4) No-harm as one-sided NI on pooled per-item differences: pass iff dbar - t_{0.95,n-1} s/sqrt(n) > -delta, delta = ceil((z_{1-a} + z_{1-b}) * SE_one-round * sqrt((1+rho)/2)), rho = 0.57; C2' 6/10/9/15/25 pt, C3' (J = 4, beta = 0.05/J) 9/13/16/14 pt; the 3-pt margin only at the version level (n = (3.29 s_d/0.03)^2, e.g. 642 SearchQA items at 4 runs; macro test ~20.5M-72M tokens/step). (5) delta_min,b = max(3, 2.486 s_d,b / sqrt(N_test,b)) = 4.8/5.7/9.0/6.3/10.0 pt. (6) Unknowns: infrastructure = pairwise exclusion (L/H direction rule as a sensitivity; re-dispatch above 2%, undetermined above 10%; Fisher test on rule-vs-parent imbalance); grader artifact = fail for both arms; truncation = scored answer; not-yet-returned cells are missing, never imputed. (7) Standing fixture (revised by the pilot): N = parent copy on the trigger union; P = task-card seed toggle on a 40-item calibration panel of the parent's training failures, 2 runs (every round on QA benchmarks, periodic on SpreadsheetBench/ALFWorld); W = six-answer spike on its own 6 items, 4 runs, as a wiring check, plus its text as a leakage canary (QA only, invisible to all roles); two placebos; a Westgard-style control chart on parent pass rate and completion length; round status calibrated/insensitive/noisy/broken/anomalous/unreferenced decided before any verdict is read. Worked example with real numbers in report Section 5.

pilot.command: old machine: bash -i /data/feasibility-scratch/D8/run2/pilot-ops/run-d8-pilot.sh /data/feasibility-scratch/D8/run2/pilot (launched by the earlier pass, 2026-10-21 00:05; this pass re-extracted with extract_pilot.py and analysed with run2/pilot/analyse_pilot.py and run3/v5_pilot_extras.py)
pilot.result: Complete: 2,000/2,000 cells, 0 unknown, 4 truncated, 333 cells with HTTP 429 resends. The six-answer spike recovered its targets (22/24 runs vs 8/24, p 3.9e-6) but raised the 194 non-targets by +5.8 pt [+2.0, +9.7] (+16.5 pt on 68 previously failing items, 0.0 on 126 others), so it is not a known-effect positive control; it also passes C1' and C2', so statistics cannot replace the leakage check. The task-card seed reproduced across sessions (+9.50 vs +8.25 pt, diff +1.25, se 1.96) and becomes the standing positive control. Session drift -1.87 pt (se 1.04), not flagged. Exploratory split-half null: the registered 1-item rule false-passes 13.6-17.3%; the exact test holds 0.5-1.8%.

risks: Simulated operating characteristics assume independent Bernoulli runs given per-item Beta posteriors; correlated runs within a round would raise the real false-positive rate (the per-round N arm is the live check). Almost all variance components and power numbers come from SearchQA / deepseek-v4-flash / temperature 0; the other benchmarks' margins rest on 1-8 judged rules each and must be re-estimated and frozen before a v5 run. Both positive controls work mainly through answer form on SearchQA (JSON replies and qualified names fail exact match), so v4's format/scorer fix may shrink them; they need re-measurement under v4/v5. The seed control (+8 to +10 pt) is far larger than any learned rule (+0.3 to +3), so its detection shows sensitivity to large effects only. No within-round seed-toggle measurement exists for OfficeQA/LiveMath/SpreadsheetBench/ALFWorld, and no spike construction exists for SpreadsheetBench/ALFWorld. Per-rule no-harm is only a gross-harm screen (a 3-pt harm passes about 50% on SearchQA under any design). The v5 design spends more of the error budget (FWER up to 0.024) and also detects real placebo-like effects (control:2 accepted 0.16-0.24). The spike text contains training reference answers and must stay invisible to every role. Simulations behind several numbers were produced by the earlier pass and not re-run in this pass.
cost_estimate: Analysis: no model calls. Pilot actually used 2,932,691 ledger tokens (= real usage). v5 fixture per gate round (estimated from measured per-cell usage): SearchQA ~0.34M with a scaffold parent / ~0.9M seeded; OfficeQA 1.0M-1.8M; LiveMath 0.26M-0.74M; SpreadsheetBench N only 0.05M-0.13M; ALFWorld N only 0.8M-3.3M. Marginal cost is about P alone when N and W replace two of v3's four placebos. Futility saves ~13.4M net of v3's 27.0M rule-arm tokens (~50%). Version-level 3-pt macro NI test: ~20.5M (scaffold) to ~72M (seeded) real tokens per step, 63-74% of it ALFWorld. Periodic full calibration (cal-1 type, 4 arms x 200 items x 4 runs) ~5M per benchmark-equivalent on SearchQA. Set caps on the ledger, which charged 26.5M vs 14.0M real in cal-1.
recommendation: Adopt report Sections 4.1-4.9 as a new protocol version (new output directory; v3 untouched) after one Codex review: exact pooled C1' + Holm + G >= 1 + beats both placebos; non-binding futility with C1-first dispatch; pre-registered NI margins stated with their power; unknowns by kind with no imputation of missing cells; the revised fixture (N + seed-toggle P + spike W as wiring check/leak canary + two placebos + control chart + round status). Before freezing: re-measure the seed control and the non-SearchQA margins under v4 (after the SearchQA format/scorer fix), with one within-round seed-toggle calibration per benchmark. Budget the version-level test explicitly (it is the only place a 3-pt no-harm claim can be made). Report Z' and power next to every verdict. Do not expect this protocol to produce acceptances on its own: per-step power for rule-sized (+0.3 to +3 pt) effects stays at 0.19-0.26; pair it with D1 (version-level fresh batches) and D9 (headroom). Main-session follow-up: correct the '21 unknown runs' line in docs/handoff/cal1-registration-20261020.md (frozen record says 15).
